original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the approved adult female character identity and clothing anchor. Reproduce this EXACT SAME fictional woman, preserving her specific facial geometry, eye shape/color, nose and lips, cheekbones, jaw, skin color, freckles/beauty marks, hairstyle/color, earrings, necklace and clothing. Do not redesign or beautify into another person. Premium consistent otome 2.5D/3D semi-realistic CG, detailed hair strands, luminous skin with subtle microtexture, fine cloth materials. Soft neutral bright studio light, solid pure WHITE background. Create ONE close-up THREE-VIEW head-and-shoulder turnaround sheet, exactly 1536x1024 landscape. Three equally spaced views: left true front 0 degrees, center true 90-degree profile facing screen RIGHT, right true rear 180 degrees. Head neck shoulders rotate together. Eye-level camera, upright head, matching scale and heights. Entire hairstyle within each view with white margin, upper chest crop, no hands. Identical physical hairstyle across views, anatomically coherent hair routing front to rear. Do not duplicate a front lock onto the back; ears hidden in back wherever hair covers them. Far eye hidden in profile; no face visible in back. Neutral closed-mouth expression. No extra angles, labels, text, lines or borders.
